title: Clinical Documentation Standard: The Group II Repeat Test for Home Oxygen Therapy
content:
# The Group II Repeat Test — Home Oxygen Therapy

**Standard.** A group II patient's repeat test supports payment of Home Oxygen Therapy from month 4 only when its retest date falls between the class's earliest and latest repeat-test days of therapy (the setup date being day 1) and its retest saturation is at or below the class's group II value. Month 4 and later of a group II patient are paid only when a repeat test received on this oxygen record meets that test. A group I patient needs no repeat test. A repeat test after the window supports payment only from the month that begins after the retest date.

The basis is the system record: the repeat tests received on this oxygen record, with their retest date and retest saturation, and the qualifying group on the oxygen record.

## Judgement table for a group II patient

| Repeat test received on this oxygen record | Retest date | Retest saturation at or below the group II value | Effect on months from month 4 |
|---|---|---|---|
| none | — | — | not paid |
| yes | within the window | yes | supports payment from month 4 |
| yes | within the window | no | does not meet the test |
| yes | after the window | yes | supports payment only from the month that begins after the retest date |

A group I patient needs no repeat test.

## Worked example (hypothetical)

A group II patient's setup date is 1 March (day 1). With a window from day 61 to day 90, the window runs from 30 April to 29 May. A qualifying repeat test dated 15 May supports payment from month 4. A qualifying repeat test dated 10 June is after the window; if the monthly billing days fall on the 1st, it supports payment only from the month beginning 1 July.
